suppress.notes:
io.netty is provided and version-managed by Elasticsearch itself; Netty CVEs are resolved by moving to the ES version that fixes them, not by anything in this repository.
The two catch-all patterns drop every finding of an io.netty artifact, regardless of score or source: the cpe rule removes the matched vulnerable-software identifiers, the vulnerabilityName rule removes the vulnerabilities themselves. (cvssBelow is not usable as a catch-all here - the schema caps it at 10 and the comparison is "strictly below", so a 10.0 finding would slip through.)
The equivalent Trivy exclusion lives in ci/trivy-ignore-policy.rego.
